dict.string: Hex uses automation to identify the foreground app and browser, pause supported media while you dictate, and let the assistant operate your apps for you.
Hex uses Accessibility to paste dictation and read selected text for Voice Action.
Hex records the other participants' audio only while you record a meeting, and keeps it on this Mac.
Hex reads your calendar on this Mac to remind you before meetings, title their recordings, and answer the assistant's questions about your day. Only what a request needs goes to your assistant.
Hex reads your reminders on this Mac when you ask the assistant about them. Only what a request needs goes to your assistant.

Hex uses your microphone for private local dictation and does not store the captured audio.
